# MtaaLink

> An all-in-one management platform for Kenyan organizations — members, money, meetings, projects, and reports.

## About
- Built in Kenya, 2025
- Founder: Elijah Sukano
- Free during early access

## Key Facts
- Runs in any browser, no app download needed
- Tracks members, contributions, meetings, projects, expenses
- Reports export to PDF
- One price: KES 2,500/month (free during early access)
